steps.title: Upload & validate
steps.detail: The browser sends the selected file as multipart/form-data. The route checks that a file exists and its MIME type is application/pdf.

steps.title: Extract page text
steps.detail: PDF.js reads every page and joins its text items. An empty extraction is rejected; this implementation does not include OCR for scanned pages.

steps.title: Create overlapping chunks
steps.detail: Whitespace is normalized. Character windows advance by 650 characters, preserving 150 characters from the previous chunk. These are character counts, not token counts.

steps.title: Generate embeddings
steps.detail: All text chunks are sent in one input array to Ollama /api/embed. The route verifies that it receives one vector for every chunk.

steps.title: Persist the book index
steps.detail: The book ID, original filename, chunk text, and vectors are written to data/books/{bookId}.json. The response includes bookId and totalChunks.
steps.payload: { bookId, bookName, chunks: [{ id, text, embedding }] }

steps.title: Ask by text or voice
steps.detail: Speech recognition can fill the text input. The user submits a message and bookId. The backend receives the current question, not the full visible conversation history.

steps.title: Embed the question
steps.detail: The same nomic-embed-text model converts the question to a vector. The route then reads the selected book index from local disk.

steps.title: Rank & check relevance
steps.detail: Each stored vector is compared with the question vector using dot product divided by the vector norms. Scores are sorted descending. If the highest score is below 0.40, generation is skipped.

steps.title: Assemble retrieved context
steps.detail: The route selects up to five highest-scoring chunks and inserts them as numbered snippets into a system prompt, instructing the model to answer from the supplied context.

steps.title: Generate the answer
steps.detail: A non-streaming request goes to Ollama /api/chat with stream: false. The application waits for the complete response. Prompt instructions encourage grounding but do not guarantee factual accuracy.

steps.title: Show sources & play audio
steps.detail: The API returns answer and sources. Readers expand the exact retrieved snippets or play the answer with speech synthesis. Browser speech recognition may rely on an online service.

steps.title: Receive an unrelated question
steps.detail: The browser submits a question outside the book with the existing bookId. This is the same API path as a relevant question.
steps.payload: How do I bake a chocolate cake?

steps.title: Embed & compare
steps.detail: Ollama embeds the question, the JSON index is loaded, and cosine similarities are calculated. Rejection avoids the answer-generation call, not all model computation.

steps.title: Take the low-score branch
steps.detail: In the recorded sample, the highest score was 0.3666. Since it was below the threshold, the route returned before calling the chat model. This is one observed example, not a guarantee for every question.

steps.title: Return an honest empty result
steps.detail: The UI displays: I could not find any relevant information in the uploaded book context. No recipe is generated and no source passages are attached.
